Title: smm2-dx
_Movies: SMM2's code has no movie library: no runtime/hle/movie.c, no FFmpeg
_SourceGlobs: The game's glue, built into the executable with the shared runtime (the host-drawn SMM1 100 Mario screens are games/smm2/mods/smm1)
_Hle: Guest symbols replaced by host code before recompiling (one mangled name per line; empty: none)
_Patches: Per-instruction patches for the generator, and the files they import (part of what the game code library is built from)
_Dump: Your own dump, extracted: the base game (v1.0.0) and the v3.0.3 update (build-helper --setup). Only the update's exefs is used (an update ships the whole exefs); its romfs goes over the base game's.
